claim: The KDS data plane API limits apply per shard. GetShardIterator has a call limit of 5 TPS. A shard iterator expires 5 minutes after it is returned to the requester, and if a GetShardIterator request is made too often, you receive a ProvisionedThroughputExceededException.

evidence.quote: The following section describes the limits for the KDS data plane APIs. KDS data plane APIs enable you to use your data streams for collecting and processing data records in real time. These limits apply per shard within your data streams.
